title: Post-Training Preference Alignment Selection: DPO vs. SimPO vs. ORPO vs. KTO vs. Two-Stage SimPO + Online GRPO

workload_basis.model: Llama-3.3-70B Full-Parameter Alignment at 8K-16K Context (16x H100 80GB)

tiers.tier: Tier 1: Standard Online-Reference DPO (Dual 70B Models in HBM + Materialized Logits)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Anti-pattern (holding frozen 70B Reference Model + materialized logits causes OOM on 80GB GPUs)

tiers.tier: Tier 2: Precomputed-Ref DPO / Adapter-Toggle LoRA DPO
tiers.recommended_scenario: Standard DPO when strict KL divergence to SFT reference is required

tiers.tier: Tier 3: Reference-Free SimPO / KTO + Liger Fused Chunked Preference Loss
tiers.recommended_scenario: Fast tone, style, safety & conciseness alignment (eliminates DPO length bias)

tiers.tier: Tier 4 (Recommended): Two-Stage Pipeline (Stage 1: SimPO + Liger Fused Loss -> Stage 2: Targeted Online Verifiable GRPO)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Enterprise agents requiring both human-preferred tone/safety AND verifiable SQL/code/math reasoning
